<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="assets/favicon.png">

<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/site.css">

<header class="mb-header">
  <a class="mb-logo" href="home.html" aria-label="Creation Studios home" style="text-decoration:none;color:inherit">
    <svg width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 216 216" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="107.5" cy="78.82" r="56.66" fill="#e8893a"/><circle cx="76.03" cy="137.58" r="56.66" fill="#3e98a4"/><circle cx="138.98" cy="137.58" r="56.66" fill="#c2234f"/><path d="M51.37,86.56c4.28,31,32.87,52.66,63.87,48.39,5.87-.81,11.57-2.53,16.91-5.11-4.28-31-32.87-52.66-63.87-48.39-5.87.81-11.57,2.53-16.91,5.11Z" fill="#eecfb9"/><path d="M82.85,129.84c28.18,13.62,62.06,1.81,75.67-26.37,2.58-5.33,4.3-11.04,5.11-16.91-28.18-13.62-62.06-1.81-75.67,26.37-2.58,5.33-4.3,11.04-5.11,16.91Z" fill="#f99977"/><path d="M107.5,184.69c26.02-17.39,33.02-52.57,15.63-78.59-4.13-6.19-9.45-11.5-15.63-15.63-26.02,17.39-33.02,52.57-15.63,78.59,4.13,6.19,9.45,11.5,15.63,15.63Z" fill="#d1a6c0"/><path d="M132.16,129.84c-15.57,7.53-33.73,7.53-49.3,0,2.21-16.04,11.19-30.37,24.65-39.37,13.47,9,22.44,23.33,24.65,39.37Z" fill="#fbd6ce"/></svg>
    <div>
      <div class="mb-logo-name">Creation Studios</div>
      <div class="mb-logo-sub">UMN Libraries · Creation Hubs</div>
    </div>
  </a>
  <nav class="mb-nav" aria-label="Studios"></nav>
</header>

<main data-mb-site="home">
  <section class="mb-hero" aria-label="Introduction">
    <div class="mb-hero-copy">
      <span class="mb-badge">Free &amp; open · UMN Libraries</span>
      <h1>Pick a studio.<br><span class="mb-highlight">Make a thing.</span></h1>
      <p>Creation Studios is the University of Minnesota Libraries' hands-on home for maker, media, and developer education. Every studio is a line of tracks and modules — hop on anywhere, open a deck, and leave with something you made.</p>
      <div class="mb-hero-actions">
        <a class="mb-btn mb-btn-primary" href="index.html">Start at the Maker studio
          <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"></path><path d="M13 6l6 6-6 6"></path></svg>
        </a>
        <a class="mb-btn mb-btn-secondary" href="about.html">More about us</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="mb-home-grid">
    <a class="mb-studio-card" href="index.html" style="--studio: var(--make)">
      <span class="mb-studio-icon"><svg width="34" height="34" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"></circle><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"></circle><path d="M20 4L8.1 15.9"></path><path d="M14.5 14.5L20 20"></path><path d="M8.1 8.1L12 12"></path></svg></span>
      <div>
        <h2>Maker</h2>
        <p>Get your hands on the machines — print, sew, cut, mill, and mold real things across the Make, Design, and Create tracks.</p>
        <div class="mb-studio-tracks">
          <span class="mb-studio-pill"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--make)"></span>Make</span>
          <span class="mb-studio-pill"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--design)"></span>Design</span>
          <span class="mb-studio-pill"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--create)"></span>Create</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </a>

    <a class="mb-studio-card" href="media.html" style="--studio: var(--capture)">
      <span class="mb-studio-icon"><svg width="34" height="34" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 12h2"></path><path d="M7 8v8"></path><path d="M11 4v16"></path><path d="M15 7v10"></path><path d="M19 10v4"></path></svg></span>
      <div>
        <h2>Media</h2>
        <p>Capture, edit, and publish footage and sound — from cameras and mics to a finished piece across the Capture, Produce, and Create tracks.</p>
        <div class="mb-studio-tracks">
          <span class="mb-studio-pill"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--capture)"></span>Capture</span>
          <span class="mb-studio-pill"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--produce)"></span>Produce</span>
          <span class="mb-studio-pill"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--create-media)"></span>Create</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </a>

    <a class="mb-studio-card" href="dev.html" style="--studio: var(--launch)">
      <span class="mb-studio-icon"><svg width="34" height="34" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 6l-6 6 6 6"></path><path d="M16 6l6 6-6 6"></path><path d="M14 4l-4 16"></path></svg></span>
      <div>
        <h2>Dev</h2>
        <p>Launch, develop, and ship software — tools, code, and publishing across the Launch, Develop, and Create tracks.</p>
        <div class="mb-studio-tracks">
          <span class="mb-studio-pill"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--launch)"></span>Launch</span>
          <span class="mb-studio-pill"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--develop)"></span>Develop</span>
          <span class="mb-studio-pill"><span class="mb-dot" style="background: var(--create-dev)"></span>Create</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </a>

    <div class="mb-studio-card">
      <span class="mb-studio-icon"><svg width="34" height="34" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 3h6a4 4 0 0 1 4 4v14a3 3 0 0 0-3-3H2z"></path><path d="M22 3h-6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v14a3 3 0 0 1 3-3h7z"></path></svg></span>
      <div>
        <h2>Open &amp; remixable</h2>
        <p>Everything here is licensed <strong>CC BY 4.0</strong> and built in the open with Quarto and RevealJS. Educators and makers are welcome to reuse, adapt, and remix the decks — see <a href="https://github.com/stevenbleau/maker_bootcamp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md" target="_blank" rel="noopener">CONTRIBUTING.md</a> if you'd like to help build the next stop.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="mb-studio-card">
      <span class="mb-studio-icon"><svg width="34" height="34" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 21s-7-4.6-9.3-8.3C1 9.2 2.6 5.5 6 5.5c2 0 3.2 1.1 4 2.3.8-1.2 2-2.3 4-2.3 3.4 0 5 3.7 3.3 7.2C19 16.4 12 21 12 21z"></path></svg></span>
      <div>
        <h2>Who makes it</h2>
        <p>Creation Studios is made by <strong>University of Minnesota Libraries — Engagement, Outreach &amp; Community Partnerships</strong>, the team behind the Creation Hubs, at <a href="https://creationstudios.org">creationstudios.org</a>. Stop by a hub, or start with any deck in a studio.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</main>

<footer class="mb-footer">
  <span>University of Minnesota Libraries · Engagement, Outreach &amp; Community Partnerships</span>

</footer>
